items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that all the separation axioms for morphisms of algebraic stacks are stable under composition (author lemma at source lines 851-856, label lemma-composition-separated). The proof (source lines 858-885) factors the diagonal of the composite through the fibre product over the middle stack, obtains the property for the two factors from the fibre product result and base change, and concludes by composition permanence for the underlying property of algebraic spaces (proof lines 858-884). The factorization of the diagonal is the substance. H3.
